x.kind: unit-RMS Gaussian, n=128 (post-RMSNorm model of FFN input)
x.note: Not cached hidden states. Isotropic x; real residual stream is anisotropic, so this is a lower bound on activation error for a given Frobenius fit.

svd_indep_r1024.kind: independent truncated SVD r=1024 on gate, up, down
